title: One issue: charged twice
text: I was charged twice for order #1042. Please refund the extra charge.
note: One specialist (billing) should act, then Jev should say everything is answered.

title: Two issues: shipping and a crash
text: Where is order #1071? Also, the app crashes every time I open the settings page.
note: Two specialists are needed. Watch Jev send the message to one, read what came back, then send it to the other.

title: Two issues: double charge and a late order
text: I was charged twice for order #1042, and order #1060 still has not arrived.
note: Billing refunds the extra charge, then shipping checks the late order.

title: Too vague to route
note: Nothing here says which team, or even that anything is wrong. Jev is close to a coin flip, so the workflow pauses and asks you. If you pick a team and the specialist cannot do much, Jev may be unsure the case is done, and ask again.

title: Angry, with a legal threat
text: This is the third time nobody has helped me. Fix my account access right now or my lawyer will be in touch.
note: A message a person should handle. Jev flags it before any specialist acts.
